description: This file defines a Java interface named ProductReviewService that extends a generic service interface for handling product review entities. It specifies methods for retrieving product reviews based on customer, product, language, or both product and customer identifiers.

classes.name: ProductReviewService
classes.description: A service interface for managing product review entities with methods to fetch reviews by customer, product, language, or both product and customer.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews submitted by a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product in a specific language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a product review associated with a specific product ID and customer ID.
